symptoms: Mottled light and dark green mosaic patterns on foliage
Leaf distortion, blistering, and stringy 'shoestring' leaves
Internal brown browning in tomato fruit wall
risk_factors: Mechanical transmission via hands, pruning shears, and smokers
prevention: Wash hands thoroughly with soap/milk before handling plants
Disinfect tools in 20% nonfat dry milk or trisodium phosphate (TSP)
recommended_actions: Remove infected plants immediately to prevent sap spread to neighbors
